lines.text: Did you know? Pend is Latin for hang.
Pension: a payment, once weighed out.
Quick quiz! Which means toward plus hang?

words.ex: My grandfather lives on a small pension.
A list of references is appended to the report.
Your loan application is still pending approval from the bank.

publish.title: Pend root: pension, append and pending
publish.value: Pend comes from Latin "pendere" (to hang, to weigh). Words: pension, append and pending. append = ap + pend.
